items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielmünde – Bußgeldbehörde.
items.computation: Page 2 shows a copy of the delivery envelope (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO): the handwritten note reads 'zugestellt 22.02.20[27]', so formal service (förmliche Zustellung) took place on Mon 22 Feb 2027 — this actual service date governs, not the deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post. The 2-week Einspruch period starts the day after service (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): counting from Tue 23 Feb 2027, two weeks end Mon 8 Mar 2027 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). 8 Mar 2027 is Frauentag, a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so the deadline shifts to the next working day, Tue 9 Mar 2027 (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG analog / § 43 Abs. 1 StPO).

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and delivery costs (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Eintragung im Fahreignungsregister: 1 Punkt. Fälligkeit des Gesamtbetrags: zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft.
items.computation: Payment falls due two weeks after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft), which only happens if no Einspruch is filed. If unchallenged, Rechtskraft is deemed to occur with the expiry of the Einspruch period, i.e. at the end of Tue 9 Mar 2027 (see the objection item above, already shifted for the MV holiday Frauentag). Counting the 2-week payment period from the day after (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), from Wed 10 Mar 2027 two weeks end Tue 23 Mar 2027 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB); that day is a normal working day, so it stands. This date only applies if no Einspruch is lodged in time; filing an Einspruch stops Rechtskraft and this payment obligation does not arise on this date.

warnings: The service date is read from a handwritten, partly unclear annotation on the enclosed envelope copy ('27 zugestellt / 22.02.20'), interpreted as 22.02.2027; if the actual Zustellung date differs, both the Einspruch deadline and the payment due date shift accordingly.

The payment due date (23.03.2027) assumes Rechtskraft occurs automatically at the end of the Einspruch period because no appeal is filed; if an Einspruch is lodged in time, the fine is not yet due and the amount may change after court review.

The IBAN on the letter (DE97 1305 0000 0000 4030 00) is a valid German IBAN for Ostseesparkasse Muster, consistent with a German authority; still verify it against a previously known official source before paying, and check the payee name match your bank reports.
